description: The router is ready: each observer receives the event once the router has booted and the observer is accepted, once per router start, and once more when its worker reconnects. Providers observe it to re-declare. Takes no args; the event is {}.

request_schema.description: The router's ready event: what `router::on-ready` returns, and what a provider's `provider::<id>::on_router_ready` receives. Currently `{}`; unknown fields are ignored.
request_schema.title: RouterReadyEvent

response_schema.description: The router's ready event: what `router::on-ready` returns, and what a provider's `provider::<id>::on_router_ready` receives. Currently `{}`; unknown fields are ignored.
